Under the Texas Code of Criminal Procedure 3814, there's a statutory rule that a conviction cannot be had upon the testimony of an accomplice witness and less cooperated by other evidence intending to connect the defendant with the offense committed. The purpose of 3814 is to ensure that the jury and not the judge determines credibility of evidence. Here, appellant was entitled to an instruction on accomplice witness rule, and it should have been issued sui sponte because it was raised by evidence. Accomplice witness is defined-

State says there must be evidence of some affirmative act. Mere presence is not enough. There's no evidence that Ms. Robinson did anything other than be present at the scene of the crime.
